capture.expected_field_source: verbose node RPC; not the benchmark's timed decoder
capture.frozen_height_reason: Bootstrap configuration was initially omitted and the node passed the intended 2048 cap; it was stopped and isolated at the actual observed validated head 6764. The selected query range remains 1..2048.

reference_source.name: Zakura frozen Mainnet JSON-RPC
reference_source.provenance: Official zakuracore/zakura:1.5.0; source commit 7632c2e15a8f46fb1485f44dd290c7b7ee08afed; expected fields from getrawtransaction verbose, block membership from getblock, identity verified with raw SHA256d; capture outside benchmark timing.

selection.rule: 128 heights: 1 + floor(i*2047/127), i=0..127; earliest transaction in block order with exact raw/verbose version 1 and no coinbase input; otherwise earliest v1 coinbase.
